questions.question: Vaqt sinxronizatsiyasi: NTP, chrony, `timedatectl`. Nega muhim?
questions.explanation: Server soati siljiydi; noto'g'ri vaqt — TLS xatolari (sertifikat "hali amal qilmaydi"), JWT exp, log korrelyatsiyasi, Kerberos, distributed DB/consensus, cron. chrony — zamonaviy NTP client (RHEL/Ubuntu), timesyncd — oddiy.

questions.question: Linux'da loglar qayerda? `/var/log` tuzilmasi, rsyslog va journald munosabati.
questions.explanation: journald — systemd'ning binary log'i (`journalctl`). rsyslog — klassik matnli loglar `/var/log/*` ga (journald'dan oladi). Asosiylar: syslog/messages, auth.log/secure, kern.log, dmesg, nginx/, apt/dnf loglari.

questions.question: Backup strategiyasi: 3-2-1, full/incremental, RPO/RTO. Linux'da qanday vositalar?
questions.explanation: 3-2-1: 3 nusxa, 2 xil media, 1 tasi offsite (va 1 immutable/offline). RPO — qancha ma'lumot yo'qotishga chidaymiz, RTO — qancha vaqtda tiklaymiz. Vositalar: rsync, tar, restic/borg (dedup, shifrlash), LVM/cloud snapshot, DB'ga xos (pg_basebackup, WAL). Restore sinalmagan backup — backup emas.

questions.question: Namespaces va cgroups: konteyner Linux darajasida nima? `unshare`, `nsenter`, cgroup v2.
questions.explanation: Namespaces — nimani ko'rishni ajratadi (pid, net, mnt, uts, ipc, user, cgroup, time). cgroups — qancha resurs ishlatishni cheklaydi (cpu, memory, io, pids). Konteyner = oddiy jarayon + namespaces + cgroups + overlayfs + capabilities/seccomp.

questions.question: Ansible asoslari: inventory, ad-hoc buyruq, playbook, idempotency. Nega shell skript emas?
questions.explanation: Agentless (SSH orqali). Inventory — hostlar va guruhlar. Ad-hoc: `ansible web -m ping`. Playbook — YAML'da istalgan holat (desired state); modullar idempotent: 2-marta ishlatsang o'zgarish bo'lmaydi (changed=0). Skriptdan farqi: idempotency, parallel, xatolarni boshqarish, dry-run (`--check --diff`).

questions.question: Markaziy loglash: loglarni bir serverga yig'ish qanday? rsyslog forwarding va zamonaviy stack.
questions.explanation: rsyslog: `*.* @@logserver:514` (TCP; `@` — UDP). Zamonaviy: agent (Fluent Bit/Vector/Promtail/Filebeat) -> Loki/Elasticsearch/OpenSearch -> Grafana/Kibana. Nega: server o'lsa loglar saqlanadi, korrelyatsiya, qidiruv, audit (buzg'unchi lokal logni o'chira oladi).

questions.question: "Kecha ishlagan edi, bugun ishlamayapti" — nima o'zgarganini qanday topasan?
questions.explanation: O'zgarishlarni yig': deploy tarixi, paket yangilanishlari (apt/dnf history), config fayllar (mtime, etckeeper/git), reboot va kernel, sertifikat muddati, disk to'lishi, tashqi bog'liqliklar (DNS, API, DB), cron. Keyin vaqt chizig'ini muammo boshlangan vaqt bilan solishtir.

questions.question: Server sozlamalarini qo'lda o'zgartirish (snowflake) va config drift muammosi. Qanday oldini olasan?
questions.explanation: Qo'lda o'zgarishlar hujjatsiz qoladi, serverlar bir-biridan farqlanadi, qayta qurib bo'lmaydi. Yechim: hamma narsa kod (Ansible/Terraform) + git review, drift aniqlash (`--check`, `terraform plan`), immutable infra, SSH'ni cheklash, /etc'ni etckeeper bilan kuzatish.

questions.question: Ops avtomatlashtirish uchun qachon Bash, qachon Python (yoki Go)?
questions.explanation: Bash — buyruqlarni zanjirlash, kichik glue script (~50 qatorgacha). Python — JSON/API, xato boshqaruvi, test, murakkab mantiq (boto3, kubernetes client). Go — tarqatiladigan CLI/operator, bitta binary. Bash'da murakkab mantiq — xato yashirinadigan joy.

questions.question: Server buzilgan (hacked) deb shubha qilasan. Nima qilasan?
questions.explanation: Vahima qilib o'chirma/reboot qilma — dalil yo'qoladi. Izolyatsiya (tarmoqdan ajrat, snapshot), dalil yig'ish (jarayonlar, ulanishlar, loglar, xotira), ta'sirni baholash, credential'larni almashtir, serverni qayta qurish (tozalashga ishonma), root cause va postmortem.

questions.question: Linux serverga monitoring/alerting: nimani kuzatasan? (node_exporter, USE, alert misollari)
questions.explanation: USE: har resurs uchun Utilization, Saturation, Errors — CPU, RAM, disk, tarmoq, FD. node_exporter -> Prometheus -> Grafana/Alertmanager. Alert simptom bo'yicha va harakatga undaydigan bo'lsin (disk 4 soatda to'ladi, emas "disk 80%").

questions.question: Ishlab turgan servisni eski serverdan yangisiga minimal downtime bilan ko'chirish rejasi.
questions.explanation: Yangi serverni IaC bilan qur -> ma'lumotni oldindan sinxronla (rsync / DB replikatsiya) -> DNS TTL'ni oldindan kamaytir -> parallel test -> qisqa freeze: oxirgi delta sync -> trafikni almashtir (LB/DNS) -> kuzat -> rollback rejasi tayyor -> eski serverni bir muddat saqla.

questions.question: Linux serverlar fleet'ida patch management (xavfsizlik yangilanishlari) qanday tashkil qilinadi?
questions.explanation: Inventar va zaiflik skaneri (qaysi CVE qayerda) -> riskka qarab SLA (critical 7 kun) -> staging/canary -> to'lqinlar bilan rollout (avtomatik health check) -> kernel uchun reboot orkestratsiyasi (drain) yoki livepatch -> hisobot. Immutable infra'da: yangi image yasab almashtirish.

questions.question: Disaster recovery: server/datacenter butunlay yo'qoldi. Tiklanish rejasi nimalardan iborat bo'ladi?
questions.explanation: RPO/RTO maqsadlari -> nima tiklanadi (infra kod sifatida, ma'lumot backup/replika, secret'lar, DNS) -> boshqa region/zona -> runbook -> muntazam DR drill. "Backup bor" yetarli emas — tiklanish vaqti o'lchangan bo'lishi kerak.

questions.question: On-call: tunda alert keldi "API p99 latency yuqori". Birinchi 15 daqiqada nima qilasan?
questions.explanation: Ta'sirni aniqlash (SLO, qaysi endpoint/region, error rate) -> o'zgarishlar (deploy, config, trafik) -> dependency'lar (DB, cache, tashqi API) -> host resurslari (USE) -> mitigation (rollback, scale, feature flag, trafik cheklash) -> kommunikatsiya -> keyin chuqur tahlil.
